text:
STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with toast, poached-style eggs, half an avocado, a latte in a mug, a lemon wedge and butter portions.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Two items. The meal of interest is on the paper plate with the eggs and avocado (side plate ~20 cm, area ~314 cm²) and the toast plate (~18 cm, area ~254 cm²). The toast plate is the one at left with toast and lemon; I treat both plates as the meal. Total plated area ~568 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Wholemeal toast (two slices, toasted)
- Lemon wedge
- Avocado half
- Two fried/poached eggs
- Butter portions (two pats)
- Latte (mug, separate from the plates, so excluded from the plated food)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate-set area ~568 cm²):
- Toast: ~14% (about 80 cm²), 2 slices stacked, height ~2.5 cm combined
- Lemon wedge: ~3% (about 17 cm²)
- Avocado: ~6% (about 34 cm²)
- Eggs: ~10% (about 57 cm²)
- Butter: ~3% (about 17 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Toast: 80 cm² x 2.5 cm = 200 ml
- Lemon: 17 cm² x 1.5 cm = 25 ml
- Avocado: 34 cm² x 2 cm = 68 ml
- Eggs: 57 cm² x 1.5 cm = 86 ml
- Butter: 17 cm² x 1 cm = 17 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk densities):
- Toast (bread-like, 0.3 for airy slices, but toast is dense-ish): 200 ml x 0.3 = 60 g. Two slices of toast are about 60 g total, which is realistic.
- Lemon: 25 ml x 0.6 = 15 g
- Avocado: 68 ml x 0.6 = 40 g
- Eggs: 86 ml x 0.95 = 82 g (two eggs ~ 100 g whole, so this is conservative)
- Butter: 17 g (two portions of ~7 g each, roughly 14 g)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Toast: 60 g x 265 kcal/100g = 159 kcal
- Lemon: 15 g x 29 = 4 kcal
- Avocado: 40 g x 160 = 64 kcal
- Eggs: 82 g x 155 = 127 kcal
- Butter: 14 g x 717 = 100 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ~228 g, ~454 kcal. This is plausible for two slices of toast, two eggs, half an avocado and butter. The latte is excluded as it is in a separate mug.
